tail:
Completed the batch 30 pair: four A-page items, two B-page examples, both draft pages, and the manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch dependency record, and batch notes.

All six Step 1 readiness records are current and `ready`; that records authoring readiness, not independent proof approval. Scoped checks passed: precheck, proof layout, rendercheck, dependency checks, content policy, strict proof contracts, coverage, and source-fetch verification. The two full-text sources are recorded in the [coverage file](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-30.coverage.json>): [Gourgoulhon](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0703035) and [Bartnik–Isenberg](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0405092).

The [pair pages](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/general-relativity/gr-fx02-conformal-constraint-construction.md>), [manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-30.pages.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-30.proof-contracts.json>), and [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-30.notes.md>) contain the work and evidence.

Two run-wide checks still need owner attention. The shared batch dependency file has a stale input hash, though batch 30 still computes to level 1 after batch 29. The run-wide item-level check reports 133 errors in other pages, including empty inventories and the level mismatch for `ex-gr-fx14-1`. Batch 30’s six item levels pass the scoped check; I left shared run metadata and off-batch content unchanged.
